_comment: Official Caribbean exchange public pages. The poller reads dated observations from these pages and never manufactures prices. Each entry's URL is the canonical public-facing daily summary or trade page; if the format ever changes, the DATE_PATTERNS / STATUS_PATTERNS regexes in watchers/market_watch_poller.py may need adjustment. To disable a market, set enabled=false (the poller still emits a source_checked_no_dated_observation row).

markets._poller: extracts 'Market Open/Closed YYYY-MM-DD' from the trade-summary page header
extracts 'Activity for D Mon YYYY' from the live summary on the homepage
extracts 'Market open/closed YYYY-MM-DD' from the homepage market summary; some pages say 'Market Summary - Friday, August 7th' which the regex tolerates
extracts 'Market Open/Closed D Mon YYYY' from the homepage market-status block; SOURCE_DISCLOSURES carries the 30-minute delay notice
extracts 'Trade Date D/M/YYYY' or any YYYY-MM-DD from the daily-trading-summary page (the SOURCE_PATHS constant in the poller carries this URL as the cayman default)
extracts 'ECSE Daily Trade Report - D Mon YYYY' from the homepage or trade report
